They are necessary to advance the field of veterinary oncology and develop more effective and safer cancer treatments. At The Cancer Vet, we offer participation in clinical trials, providing your pet with access to innovative treatments that may not be available elsewhere. Our team follows rigorous protocols to ensure the safety and well-being of your pet throughout the trial. You can leverage our clinical trials by discussing with our team whether your pet is a suitable candidate for any ongoing trials.
